description: The Air Carrier Statistics database, known as T-100 and reported on Form 41 Traffic schedules, contains monthly traffic and capacity data reported to the Bureau of Transportation Statistics by US certificated air carriers and, in the all-carriers version, by foreign carriers serving the United States. Segment tables give, for each carrier, non-stop airport pair, aircraft type and service class, departures scheduled and performed, available seats and capacity, passengers, freight and mail carried, distance and ramp-to-ramp and airborne hours; market tables give on-flight origin and destination traffic, in domestic and international versions. Tables are downloadable free from TranStats as CSV with field selection, a domestic T-100 layer is published on the BTS geospatial hub, and third-party aggregated copies (for example 1990 to 2026 on figshare) circulate. As US government statistics the data are unrestricted. Caveats: small carriers report separately on Form 298C, and passenger counts are on-flight, not true itineraries, for which the DB1B ticket sample is the counterpart. T-100 describes the demand and capacity of the air network for network flow, airport capacity planning and disruption studies, and is related to the on-time performance data.
